description: Search the code graph for symbols matching a name (exact or substring). Returns ranked matches with name, kind, file:line, and signature.

include_values.description: Include synthetic value-flow slots (a callable's locals, parameters and return values, minted for semantic value lineage). Excluded by default: they carry bare source identifiers and displace real symbols for common names. Default false.

name.description: Symbol name to search for (exact or substring match).

name: SearchEntity
